description: Ask whether a purpose (ai.train, data.public, face.recognize, ai.looks, app.data) may be used for up to 500 people (L24, data and AI by consent). A service asks before every use of a person's content or likeness for one of those purposes; an answer is cached at most 60 s and dropped on network.consent.changed, and a service that cannot reach Network treats every purpose as off.
